quantize_weights: quantize a torch tensor to integer format using a specified ScalarType and optional group size
gptq_quantize_weights: quantize weights using GPTQ algorithm with optional activation order permutation
is_layer_skipped: check whether a model layer should be skipped during quantization based on ignored layer patterns
get_linear_quant_method: get the appropriate quantization method class for a linear layer with dynamic config overrides
get_dynamic_override: override quantization config parameters for a layer matching a dynamic pattern rule
